metadata.title: Alu Muri | Spiced Potatoes With Puffed Rice
metadata.description:
This spicy and tangy snack is a great delight for any Shillongite or even to someone who has visited Shillong for a short while. This lip smacking combination of soft boiled potatoes, aromatic spices and crispy puffed rice is unquestionably irresistible.
